component.name: Node-RED Contrib AbraFlexi
component.summary: Node-RED input node that receives AbraFlexi Changes-API webhooks

description.p: Receives AbraFlexi (FlexiBee) webhook POST requests and emits one Node-RED message per change record, enabling event-driven flows that react to ERP changes in near real-time without polling.

Supports optional X-FB-Hook-SecKey header validation with the secret stored encrypted in Node-RED credentials. Output messages carry the evidence type as topic, the operation (create/update/delete), and the full change record as payload.
